fusions.name: Out of Stillness
fusions.desc: A darting lunge that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Sheds your tail, which thrashes and deals 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 30% chance to be turned against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Not a Twitch
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Anything it holds moves 25% slower for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Hours
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
